purpose: Prepare explicit per-origin cereal area/work/food activities so later seasonality cannot reuse land, workers or surplus invisibly.
inputs: Pinned existing November16 control/candidate supply packets and November12 input caches, archived farm-work crop identities and existing crop energy/arable/geography packets. Preserve current r5 publication and all fixed scenario settings.
method: Read archived inputs and recover stable grid-origin IDs, cereal identity, potential and retained cropped hectares, net cereal kcal/ha, rural people/need, effective workers, annual listed/reaping work and surplus for each existing case. A literal replay of the existing field-support arithmetic is permitted only as an exact control, with original summary identity and documented float packet precision. Do not call climate/crop/route/placement builders or add scenarios.
control: Cross-check archived crop choice/work units and all32 existing scalar work/grain cases before using the new packet. Distinguish majority-land transport mask from land-fraction crop hectares. Preserve source IDs, residuals, undefined crop/area cases and missing definitions; no silent clamping or precision substitution.
deliverable: Compact per-origin activity packet, independent area/work/source-identity checks and an inspection figure showing where annual constraints bind. State clearly that human/draft/processing schedules and complete land-use budgets remain unqualified.
exclusions: No new scenario sweep, fit, complete occupation/diet claim, warehouse allocation, invented non-reaping windows, population adoption, atlas/default change, reserved evidence pool or climate development.
